specification.description: Gold woven sling bag with a contemporary profile and standard shape, suited to formal styling. Its compact silhouette is finished with a softly lustrous surface and a neat shoulder strap.
construction_details: Woven exterior with softly structured base
Fold-over flap with concealed magnetic snap
specification.care_instructions: Wipe lightly with a soft, dry cloth and store in its dust bag. Keep away from moisture and abrasive surfaces.

quality_adjustments: Synthetic capacity defined as 70% of external volume, rounded down to 0.1 L, to correct impossible generated volume.
